Name: Poke Horse - Poke Ball Horse Summon and Recall (EN ES ZH)
Author: POCHIMODS
Description:

[center][color=#cba96a][b]English  •  Español  •  简体中文[/b][/color][/center]

[size=4][b]English[/b][/size]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092709-1440957683.png[/img][/center]
A reusable Poké Ball for your own horse, with an animated throw, sparkles and original sounds. Hidden while selected.
[b]Left-click:[/b] summon outdoors. [b]Right-click:[/b] recall without aiming, even from another map. Dismount first.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092709-381585139.png[/img][/center]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (Windows x64), [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], a stable and a named horse. No Content Patcher needed.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092713-656943849.png[/img][/center]
Extract [b]PokeHorse[/b] into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI. Keep one inventory slot free to receive the ball.
[b]Console:[/b] pokehorse_ball — extra ball · pokehorse_recover — recover your horse.
[size=2]Beta: full in-game and multiplayer testing pending.[/size]

[line]
[size=4][b]Español[/b][/size]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092713-1920771039.png[/img][/center]
Una Poké Ball reutilizable para tu caballo, con lanzamiento animado, destellos y sonidos originales. No aparece sobre la cabeza.
[b]Clic izquierdo:[/b] sacar en exteriores. [b]Clic derecho:[/b] recoger sin apuntar, incluso desde otro mapa. Baja del caballo primero.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092716-1086028681.png[/img][/center]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (Windows x64), [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], un establo y un caballo con nombre. No necesita Content Patcher.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092716-161059715.png[/img][/center]
Extrae [b]PokeHorse[/b] en [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] e inicia con SMAPI. Deja un hueco libre para recibir la bola.
[b]Consola:[/b] pokehorse_ball — otra bola · pokehorse_recover — recuperar al caballo.
[size=2]Beta: pruebas completas en partida y multijugador pendientes.[/size]

[line]
[size=4][b]简体中文[/b][/size]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092719-363587375.png[/img][/center]
用可重复使用的精灵球召唤和收回自己的马，包含投球动画、闪光与原创音效。选中时不会举在头顶。
[b]鼠标左键：[/b]在室外召唤。[b]鼠标右键：[/b]无需瞄准即可收回，也支持跨地图。请先下马。

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092720-1211653021.png[/img][/center]
Windows x64 版《星露谷物语》1.6.15、[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]、一座马厩和一匹已取名的马。不需要 Content Patcher。

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53954/53954-1792092722-1821192702.png[/img][/center]
将 [b]PokeHorse[/b] 解压到 [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b]，通过 SMAPI 启动。请预留一个背包空位领取精灵球。
[b]控制台：[/b]pokehorse_ball — 再领一个球 · pokehorse_recover — 找回坐骑。
